passage: The annual volunteer day is moving from Friday to Saturday after partner organizations said weekday events disrupted their services. Employees who participate will receive a floating day off to use within 60 days. Transportation and lunch are provided, and family members over age 12 may join. Registration closes September 18.

keyPoints.text: Volunteer day is moving from Friday to Saturday to avoid disrupting partner services.
Participating employees receive a floating day off usable within 60 days.

referenceAnswer: Volunteer day moves to Saturday, with participants receiving a floating day off; registration closes September 18.
